body.name: \Lambda_{\mathrm{pub}}
body.construction: For the exact graph with latent node \(0\), observed nodes \(1,2,3\), and edges \(0\to1\), \(0\to2\), \(0\to3\), \(1\to2\), and \(2\to3\), use the released row-vector residual transform \[L_{\mathrm{pub}}=\begin{pmatrix}1&-\gamma_1&-\gamma_2&-\gamma_3\\0&1&-u&0\\0&0&1&-\beta\\0&0&0&1\end{pmatrix},\qquad \Lambda_{\mathrm{pub}}=\begin{pmatrix}\gamma_1&1&0&0\\u\gamma_1+\gamma_2&u&1&0\\\beta(u\gamma_1+\gamma_2)+\gamma_3&\beta u&\beta&1\end{pmatrix}.\] The latter is the observed-row block of \(L_{\mathrm{pub}}^{-\mathsf T}\). Define \(m_{ik}=\sum_{j=0}^3\omega_j^{(2)}(\Lambda_{\mathrm{pub}})_{ij}(\Lambda_{\mathrm{pub}})_{kj}\) and \(c_{ik\ell}=\sum_{j=0}^3\omega_j^{(3)}(\Lambda_{\mathrm{pub}})_{ij}(\Lambda_{\mathrm{pub}})_{kj}(\Lambda_{\mathrm{pub}})_{\ell j}\). The retained coordinates are exactly \(\mathbf m^{(2)}=(m_{11},m_{12},m_{13},m_{22},m_{23},m_{33})\) and \(\mathbf c=(c_{111},c_{112},c_{113},c_{122},c_{123},c_{133},c_{222},c_{223},c_{233},c_{333})\).
